calibration_diagnostics.calibration_assessment: Because the held-out validation sample has only N=42 examples (21 benign, 21 injection), empirical calibration curves exhibit high sampling variance. While Platt sigmoid calibration slightly reduces log-loss, the underlying classifier outputs remain monotonic decision-boundary rankings rather than robust Bayesian posterior probabilities. Ingress filtering must not treat raw output scores as calibrated probabilities.
